chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadala from Al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman from 'Abdullah ibn Muskhan from Al-Halabi from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When a man sneezes during the prayer, he should say: 'All praise is due to Allah.'"

key_terms.اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: All praise is due to Allah

ai.seo_question: What should a person say if they sneeze while performing prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific etiquette of *dhikr* during prayer, distinguishing the response to a sneeze from the general greeting of peace. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining the continuity of worship by integrating brief, prescribed remembrances without disrupting the prayer's structure. The ruling underscores the importance of mindful awareness (*hudur al-qalb*) even in minor physical actions during *salat*.
